title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and pepper.
steps: Boil salted water and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Fry pancetta in a pan until crispy.
Whisk eggs with grated cheeses and black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving some pasta water.
Remove pan from heat, mix in pasta, then egg mixture.
Add pasta water gradually to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Tender chicken in a rich, spiced tomato and cream sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until slightly charred.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in oil.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and add grilled chicken.
Simmer for 10 more minutes.
Serve with naan or rice.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Quick and healthy breakfast with creamy avocado on crispy bread.
steps: Toast the sourdough slices until golden and crispy.
Cut avocado in half, remove pit, and scoop into bowl.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread mashed avocado generously onto toast.
Top with red pepper flakes and fresh herbs.
Add a poached or fried egg on top if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Beef Tacos
summary: Juicy seasoned ground beef in crunchy taco shells with fresh toppings.
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat.
Drain excess fat from the pan.
Add taco seasoning and water, stir to combine.
Simmer until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Warm taco shells in oven at 180°C for 3 minutes.
Fill shells with beef mixture.
Top with cheese, lettuce, tomato, sour cream, and salsa.

title: Pancakes
summary: Fluffy, golden pancakes perfect for a weekend morning.
steps: Mix dry ingredients: flour, sugar, baking powder, soda, salt.
In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir until just combined.
Heat a greased pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake onto the pan.
Cook until bubbles form, then flip.
Cook other side until golden. Serve with maple syrup.

title: Caesar Salad
summary: Crisp romaine lettuce with creamy Caesar dressing and croutons.
steps: Wash and dry romaine lettuce leaves.
Tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Place in a large salad bowl.
Drizzle Caesar dressing over lettuce and toss well.
Add croutons and Parmesan shavings.
Season with black pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve immediately.
